tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Hebrew Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineHebrew: סטודיו אופליין לזיהוי ועריכת כתב יד תורני ומחברות שיעורים
releaseTitle: v1.3.0 — Complete Rebrand to 'Ohr HaKsav' (אור הכתב), Workflow Clarity Overhaul & Distraction-Free UI
description: Ohr HaKsav (אור הכתב) v1.3.0 establishes the permanent dignified identity of the software with brand-new radiant 3D illumination artwork, renames core workflow buttons to 'Save & Learn Mistakes', hides document stats by default for a clean distraction-free proofreading view (toggleable via View > Show Statistics), adds rich hover ScreenTips across all menus, and retains full backward compatibility for existing profile data.
features: Permanent Dignified Name: Officially renamed to 'Ohr HaKsav' (אור הכתב - 'Light of the Script'), completely abandoning all prior working titles.
Brand-New Radiant 3D Emblem: Features an antique Torah manuscript illuminated by a golden ray of light transforming handwritten script into glowing digital typography.
Workflow Button Clarity ('🎓 Save & Learn Mistakes'): Replaced generic 'Save' with an explicit action button explaining that edits teach the memory engine for future scans.
Distraction-Free Proofreading Canvas: Stats text underneath the editor (Words, Characters, Lines) is hidden by default and accessible via View > Show Statistics & Details (Ctrl+Shift+S).
Interactive Workflow Banner: Added a helpful proofreading guide above the editor outlining the 4-step transcription-to-learning process.
Rich Hover ScreenTips (Industry Standard): Hovering over buttons and menus displays structured cards explaining features, workflow steps, and keyboard shortcuts.
Full Backward Data Compatibility: Automatically detects and migrates existing handwriting profiles, mistake memories, and backups from %APPDATA%\KsavKooker to %APPDATA%\OhrHaKsav without loss.
Domain Folder Redirection & Light Mode: Includes full support for Windows Server domain shares (\\newltcserver\...) and native Light Mode default.
